description:
Drawdown check: what it cost to collect the return you were shown. The coin is bought at the close of every day of its history and held for the period you name: you get the drawdown from the entry before the period was out, the share of starts that fell 30% and 50%, the days spent under water, how it ended — and, among the starts that ended in profit, the drawdown they sat through first. Spot tape, no fees, coins that died included.

Use when a return is quoted for holding a coin ("BTC did +150% in a year") and you want the fall endured on the way. With leverage use leverage_survival; to test a stop that cuts the fall, stop_loss_check.

inputSchema.description: The hold you want opened on every day there has been.

coin.description: Ticker or full pair. An unknown one comes back with the list we hold and the ones left out.

days.description: How long it is held: 30, 90, 365 or 730.

name: drawdown_check

outputSchema.description: What holding that coin for that long cost, across every possible starting day.

asset_max_drawdown.description: The coin's own biggest top-to-bottom fall, with dates and days to recover, for comparison.

median_days_under_water.description: Days of the hold spent below the entry price, middle start.

median_worst_fall_among_winners_pct.description: Among the starts that ended in profit, the median fall they sat through first. The price of the number you were shown. A return without this is advertising.

median_worst_fall_pct.description: The middle start's worst fall from its own entry price within the hold.

ok.description: false when we do not hold that data. Never a zero standing in for an answer.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence, and what we do have instead.

share_fell_30_pct.description: Share of starts that fell 30% or more from entry first.

share_in_profit_pct.description: Share of starts that ended up.

share_never_recovered_pct.description: Starts that never closed back at their entry price within the hold.

source.description: The public file these numbers come from.

starts.description: Start days tested. Fewer than 120 and we refuse to give a percentage.

title: Drawdown check
